rule: Archetypes are descriptive lenses for incidence later — not ideals and not recommendations.

archetypes.label: Wage-earning family with children
archetypes.composition: Two adults or one adult + dependents
archetypes.geographic_sensitivity: High — childcare and commute differ sharply by place

archetypes.label: Single earner / single adult household
archetypes.composition: One adult, with or without dependents
archetypes.income_position: Often below median; higher rent share risk
archetypes.geographic_sensitivity: High in rural areas with thin job density

archetypes.label: Fixed-income older household
archetypes.income_position: Fixed income; asset rich / cash poor possible

archetypes.label: Rural working household tied to production
archetypes.composition: Farm, plant, logistics, or trades employment

archetypes.label: Metro professional dual-earner household
archetypes.composition: Two earners; NWA or Central corridor common

archetypes.label: Transfer-supported / disability-constrained household
archetypes.composition: Adults with disability or care responsibility
archetypes.income_position: Often below median; benefit cliffs matter
archetypes.geographic_sensitivity: Very high where HPSA and transit are thin
